'''Thiago Pitarch Pinar''' (born 3 August 2007) is a Spanish professional [[Association football|footballer]] who plays as a [[midfielder]] for [[La Liga]] club [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]].

==Early life==
Thiago Pitarch Pinar was born in [[Fuenlabrada]], Spain and he acquired a double nationality of Spanish and Moroccan as his grandfather is originally from [[Al Hoceima]].<ref name=":1" />
==Club career==
===Youth career===
Pitarch started his youth career at [[Atlético Madrid]] academy, where he spent five years. In 2018, he moved to the [[Getafe CF|Getafe]] academy where he stayed until 2022. He then moved to [[CD Leganés|Leganés]] for one season before joining [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]] in 2023.<ref name=":0"> {{Cite web |last=S. Tavero|first=Fernando |title=La sensación es Thiago Pitarch|trans-title=The sensation is Thiago Pitarch |url=https://as.com/futbol/primera/la-sensacion-es-thiago-pitarch-n/|language=es |date=8 August 2025 |access-date=9 August 2025 |website=Diario AS |archive-date=9 August 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250809202551/https://as.com/futbol/primera/la-sensacion-es-thiago-pitarch-n/ |url-status=live}}</ref><ref name=":1"> {{Cite web |last=Pacheco|first=Jorge|title=Quién es Thiago Pitarch, la joya de la cantera del Real Madrid que marcó un gol en su debut con Xabi Alonso|trans-title= Who is Thiago Pitarch, the jewel of the Real Madrid youth academy who scored a goal on his debut under Xabi Alonso|url=https://www.elespanol.com/deportes/futbol/20250805/thiago-pitarch-joya-cantera-real-madrid-marco-gol-debut-xabi-alonso/1003743875167_0.html| language=es |date=9 August 2025 | access-date=9 August 2025 |website=El Español}}</ref>

At Real Madrid, Pitarch started playing in the Juvenil C team before making the jump to Juvenil B ahead of the 2024–25 season. In January 2025, coach [[Álvaro Arbeloa]] promoted him to Juvenil A, where Pitarch became a starter.<ref name=":2"> {{Cite web |last=Tamaral|first=Silvia|title=El Madrid se frota las manos con Thiago Pitarch|trans-title= Madrid rubs its hands with Thiago Pitarch|url=https://www.marca.com/futbol/real-madrid/2025/07/30/madrid-frota-manos-thiago-pitarch.html| language=es |date=30 July 2025 | access-date=9 August 2025 |website=MARCA}}</ref> Later in July 2025, he was promoted to their [[Real Madrid Castilla|reserve team]].<ref>{{cite web |last=Leveridge |first=Sam |url=https://www.forbes.com/sites/samleveridge/2025/08/20/who-is-real-madrid-prodigy-thiago-pitarch/ |title=Who Is Real Madrid Prodigy Thiago Pitarch? |publisher=Forbes |date=20 August 2025 }}</ref> In August 2025, he extended his contract with the club until 2030.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://sports.yahoo.com/article/official-real-madrid-academy-gem-123000794.html |title=Official: Real Madrid academy gem signs new contract with club |publisher=Yahoo! Sports |date=16 August 2025 }}</ref>

=== First team breakthrough ===
On 17 February 2026, Pitarch made his senior debut as a substitute in the stoppage time of 1–0 away win over [[S.L. Benfica|Benfica]] in the [[UEFA Champions League|Champions League]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.aljazeera.com/sports/liveblog/2026/2/17/live-benfica-vs-real-madrid-champions-league-playoff |title=Benfica vs Real Madrid 0-1: Champions League playoff – as it happened |publisher=Al Jazeera |date=17 February 2026 }}</ref>

==International career==
Born in Spain, Pitarch is of Moroccan descent through his grandfather and is eligible to play for both [[Spain national football team|Spain]] and [[Morocco national football team|Morocco]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.elespanol.com/deportes/futbol/20250805/thiago-pitarch-joya-cantera-real-madrid-marco-gol-debut-xabi-alonso/1003743875167_0.html|title=Quién es Thiago Pitarch, la joya de la cantera del Real Madrid que marcó un gol en su debut con Xabi Alonso|first=Jorge|last=Pacheco|date=9 August 2025|website=El Español}}</ref> He played for Spain at the [[2025 FIFA U-20 World Cup]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Estos son los 21 futbolistas que defenderán a España en el Mundial Sub-20 de Chile|lang=es|trans-title=These are the 21 players who will defend Spain in the Under-20 World Cup in Chile|url=https://rfef.es/es/noticias/estos-son-los-21-futbolistas-que-defenderan-espana-en-el-mundial-de-chile|website=[[Royal Spanish Football Federation]]|date=17 September 2025}}</ref>

==Style of play==
Pitarch plays as a midfielder. He is capable of connecting lines, stepping into the area to score goals, and has precise ball distribution in midfield.<ref name=":0"/><ref name=":1"/>
